title: Pune fort murder | The scorpion’s sting
description: Ketan Agarwal was engaged to Siya Goyal in February and a lavish wedding was planned for November. On June 18, Ketan was found dead at the bottom of a 400-foot gorge at Lohagad Fort in Pune. What followed was a police investigation that peeled back, layer by layer, a plot allegedly months in the making
